theorem ext_vanishing_equivalence
  {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R]
  {I : Ideal R}
  {M : Type*} [AddCommMonoid M] [Module R M]
  (hM_nontrivial : Nontrivial M)
  (hM_finite : Module.Finite R M)
  (hI_proper : Submodule.smul (I.map (Submodule.subtype (⊤ : Submodule R R))) M ≠ ⊤)
  (n : ℕ) :
  (∀ (N : Type*) [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R N],
    Nontrivial N → Module.Finite R N →
    Module.support R N ⊆ PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus I →
    ∀ i < n, Subsingleton (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext R N M i))
  ↔ (∀ i < n, Subsingleton (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext R (R ⧸ I) M i))
  ↔ (∃ (N : Type*) [AddCommMonoid N] [Module R N],
    Nontrivial N ∧ Module.Finite R N ∧
    Module.support R N = PrimeSpectrum.zeroLocus I ∧
    ∀ i < n, Subsingleton (CategoryTheory.Abelian.Ext R N M i))
  ↔ (∃ (seq : Fin n → R), (∀ i, seq i ∈ I) ∧
    ∀ i : Fin n, Function.Injective (fun m : M => seq i • m)) :=
  sorry
